goal: Make Liran's administrator login failure self-diagnosing and recoverable without changing her approved account or permissions.

intent_model.literal_request: Liran receives an unauthorized error and cannot enter.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Liran can enter with the approved Google account, and a wrong account clearly explains what happened and how to recover.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Diagnose the persisted grant, identity binding and live failure path end to end.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Requires live readback and a recovery state, not only a source change.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Which Google account was selected and whether it matches an approved administrator.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Start Google login again and select the approved account.

facts.claim: Liran has an active grant for all 12 delegated modules.
The grant is not bound to a Google identity and no identity_bound audit event exists.

facts.evidence: Live grant and Adir's saved Google contact for Liran Swissa.

assumptions.claim: The rejected attempt selected a different Google identity or never reached a matching first-login bind.
assumptions.validation: Show the verified selected email on the failure screen and inspect the next live audit event.

out_of_scope: Changing Liran's approved email without evidence
invariants: Customer and administrator sessions remain separate
Only verified Google profiles can bind
Wrong email or Google subject stays denied
Saved module permissions do not widen

requirements.statement: The forbidden admin state identifies the selected Google account and gives a single account-switch action.
The correct invited account can bind on first successful login while mismatches remain denied.
The retry preserves the intended safe administrator destination.

acceptance_checks.setup: Valid admin session cookie for an unapproved Google account
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The admin login page displays that email and offers choosing another Google account.

acceptance_checks.action: Resolve the exact email and subject
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The first identity binds and receives only saved modules.

acceptance_checks.action: Resolve the same email with a different Google subject

acceptance_checks.setup: Forbidden visit to a delegated admin route
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The safe original admin route is retained.

acceptance_checks.action: Reload admin users and login routes without cache
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The grant remains active, audit remains intact and the diagnostic UI is served by the public release.

open_questions.question: Which Google account did Liran select in the failed attempt?
open_questions.resolution: The repaired failure screen exposes the verified selected account without granting access.

authorization_boundary: Code, tests and publication are authorized by the request; no outbound message or change to Liran's approved identity is authorized.
